how_it_works: A file under sql/ runs on BigQuery as follows: if sql/dialects/bigquery/<same path> exists it is used; otherwise the Postgres file is transpiled with sqlglot. Files using Postgres-only features must have a counterpart or be listed here with the reason they are not needed.

not_needed.sql/build/security/: BigQuery grants access with IAM roles, authorized views and column-level policy tags, not SQL GRANTs to database roles.
not_needed.sql/checks/rules/privacy/personal_data_v: On BigQuery, value-level personal data scanning is a Cloud DLP (Sensitive Data Protection) inspection job on the dataset.
not_needed.sql/defects/: Test harness: bugs injected into the local Postgres build.
not_needed.sql/incidents/: Test harness: incidents simulated on the local Postgres build.
not_needed.sql/schema_changes/: Test harness: schema changes applied to the local Postgres build.
not_needed.sql/fixtures/: Test harness: the Postgres sandbox for hand-built change feeds.
not_needed.sql/queries/partitions/: Pruning on BigQuery is enforced by require_partition_filter and measured in bytes (sql/dialects/bigquery/checks/cost/), not read from EXPLAIN.
not_needed.sql/queries/incremental/tables_of_schema: Test harness: lists Postgres tables to checksum a local build.
not_needed.sql/queries/quality/: Test harness: flaky-test history in the local results database.
not_needed.sql/results/: Results store of the local runner; on Google Cloud results go to a BigQuery dataset created by the runner.
not_needed.sql/build/history/10_hist_schema.sql: CREATE SCHEMA is part of each BigQuery build script (CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS).
not_needed.sql/build/latest/20_latest_schema.sql: CREATE SCHEMA is part of each BigQuery build script (CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS).
